# Personal Portfolio Website

## Overview

This project was developed as part of **DATA 555: Data Visualization in Public Health** and serves as my professional online portfolio. The website was designed to showcase my academic background, professional experiences, technical skills, certifications, and projects in epidemiology, public health, and data science.

The website provides a centralized platform where recruiters, collaborators, and academic professionals can learn about my educational journey, research experience, technical competencies, and career interests. It highlights my transition from a medical background to advanced training in epidemiology and data science, while demonstrating my commitment to leveraging data-driven approaches to improve public health outcomes.

## Objectives

- Create a professional online presence.
- Showcase academic and professional achievements.
- Present technical skills and certifications.
- Highlight public health, epidemiology, and data science projects.
- Provide easy access to my resume, portfolio, and contact information.
- Demonstrate web publishing and digital communication skills.

## Key Features

### About Me
Provides an overview of my background as a physician and public health professional with training in Epidemiology and Data Science.

### Education
Highlights my academic journey, including:

- MBBS
- Master of Public Health (MPH) in Epidemiology
- Data Science coursework and certifications

### Skills
Showcases technical and analytical skills including:

- R Programming
- Python
- SQL
- GIS
- Epidemiologic Methods
- Biostatistics
- Data Visualization
- Machine Learning
- Public Health Analytics

### Projects
Features selected projects involving:

- Epidemiologic research
- Data analysis
- Public health data visualization
- WASH and global health research
- Statistical programming

### Certifications
Displays professional certificates and completed coursework that support continued professional development.

### Professional Experience
Summarizes research, public health, and analytical experiences that demonstrate practical application of epidemiologic and data science methods.

### Contact Information
Provides multiple ways for visitors, recruiters, and collaborators to connect professionally.

## Technologies Used

- R
- R Markdown
- GitHub Pages
- HTML
- CSS
- Data Visualization Tools
- Version Control with Git and GitHub

## Learning Outcomes

Through this project, I gained experience in:

- Personal branding and professional communication
- Website development and deployment
- GitHub Pages publishing
- Digital portfolio design
- Presenting technical and academic achievements to diverse audiences
- Communicating public health and data science work through web-based platforms

## Impact

This website serves as a comprehensive digital portfolio that brings together my education, projects, certifications, and professional experiences in one accessible location. It supports networking, career development, and collaboration opportunities while showcasing my interdisciplinary expertise in medicine, epidemiology, public health, and data science.
